title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-view 3D transformers such as VGGT reconstruct a scene from a set of unposed images in a single forward pass, predicting camera poses, depth and 3D points, but the cost of their global attention grows quadratically with the num- ber of images. Accelerators borrowed from large language models assume that each token attends to only a few oth- ers; on these models they lose accuracy or gain little speed. We study the global attention of three multi-view transform- ers on seven datasets and find that every layer plays one of three roles: it averages over the whole scene, matches points across many images, or anchors on the first image, whose coordinates the outputs use. Building on this anal- ysis, we propose Regime-AWare ATTention Approximation (RAWATTA), a training-free method that runs attention in 8- bit precision and keeps 16-bit precision only in the layers where a worst-case calibration check requires it. translated_title: 基于模式感知注意力近似的免训练多视角3D Transformer加速
translated_abstract: 诸如VGGT之类的多视角3D Transformer能够通过单次前向传播从一组无位姿图像中重建场景，预测相机位姿、深度和3D点，但其全局注意力的计算开销随图像数量呈二次方增长。从大语言模型借鉴而来的加速器假设每个token只关注少数其他token；在这些模型上，这类方法要么损失精度，要么提速有限。我们研究了三个多视角Transformer在七个数据集上的全局注意力，发现每一层都扮演以下三种角色之一：对整个场景进行平均、在多幅图像之间匹配点，或锚定在第一张图像上（输出的坐标基于该图像）。基于这一分析，我们提出了模式感知注意力近似，这是一种免训练的方法，以8位精度运行注意力，仅在最坏情况校准检查所要求的层中保留16位精度。其快速设置RA……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 通过揭示多视角3D Transformer中每层全局注意力只承担三种功能模式之一，提出免训练的RAWATTA方法，仅在必要的层保留16位精度、其余层以8位精度近似注意力，从而在保持精度的同时大幅加速推理。
